info.name: Larridin Scout Adoption Workflow Intelligence API

description.content:
The Larridin Scout API exposes the metrics behind Larridin Scout: AI adoption, AI proficiency (fluency), AI tool inventory and policy enforcement, employee surveys, and workflow intelligence. All documented endpoints are read-only (GET) and return the standard Scout envelope `{ "success": true, "data": {...}, "query": {...} }`.

Generated by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline as a faithful transcription of the provider's public reference at https://docs.larridin.com/api/scout-api-v1-reference. It is not a provider-published specification.
